warnings.why: Official reports of 99 percent immunization for HepB3 in North Korea are historically implausible given widespread systemic health infrastructure challenges and chronic undernutrition.

A reported rate of 39 percent amidst active nationwide conflict and the near-total collapse of the healthcare system in 2024 is likely an outdated or artifactual estimate rather than a reliable current measurement.

policy: model memory is advisory; unsupported suspicions cannot overrule official data
